title: A line the supervisor wrote for the owner says what became of the tasks it names; one whose tasks have all ended is settled and off Home's card
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/attention.rs (`said`, `for_owner`, the `supervisor.for_owner` list of `/api/attention` and its module comment), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/labels.rs (`Context`, where the tasks and their states are already read), web/src/attention.ts (`OwnerNote`), web/src/home.ts (`latestNotes`) and web/src/components/home/Home.tsx (`SupervisorNotes`, the "From the supervisor" card), and web/src/components/fleet/FleetView.tsx (where every line is listed).

The problem, on the live fleet (read-only /api/attention, 2026-11-12 00:11 +08; sync/queue.md rev-b 00:11 and lead-mac 00:30; sync/roadmap-effects.md in-flight item 6). The supervisor wrote "For the owner: reports 198, 204, 208 and 211 (missions 7/8) are still waiting for your ccd review" at 11-11 06:23Z, and the line has been in `supervisor.for_owner` for 30 h. All four tasks had ended 37 to 50 h before it was written: 198, 204 and 211 were accepted, 208 cancelled. So it was false when written and is false now. Home's "From the supervisor" card counts it in "1 more", shows it when opened, and has nothing to say it is settled: the API passes a line's words on as the transcript has them, and nothing reads the tasks it names.

Required behaviour.
(a) Every `supervisor.for_owner` item of `/api/attention` carries `tasks`: the tasks its line names, in the line's order, each once, as `{id, state}` with the task's state now. A line names a task as `#<n>`, as `T<n>`, or by a number listed after the word task, tasks, report or reports ("reports 198, 204, 208 and 211"). Numbers naming no task are left out.
(b) It also carries `settled`: true when the line names at least one task and every one has ended (accepted, landed or cancelled); false otherwise, including a line that names no task.
(c) web/src/home.ts: `latestNotes` leaves a settled line out. It is neither shown nor counted in `more`.
(d) The supervisor's full list of lines (FleetView) still shows a settled line, marked settled, with each named task's state.
(e) The module comment of attention.rs says (a) and (b).

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/064.sh. A real `spawn loop` runs with the supervisor on, and `spawn serve` answers. A fake engine writes each turn's words to its transcript as Claude Code does, and a fake model judge answers the Observer. A review mission has tasks 2 to 5: 2 and 3 are accepted and 4 cancelled by the owner (`spawn task accept`, `spawn task cancel`); 5 is reported and waits. The supervisor then writes three lines, a turn each:
- "For the owner: deploy main to pick up the new cost page." (no task);
- "For the owner: task #5 waits for your review.";
- newest, "For the owner: reports 2, 3 and 4 are still waiting for your review."
Checks:
- (1) and (2) Through `GET /api/attention`, the reports line has tasks [{2, accepted}, {3, accepted}, {4, cancelled}] and settled true; the #5 line has [{5, reported}] and false; the deploy line has [] and false.
- (3) Under node, `latestNotes` over that answer shows the #5 and deploy lines, not the reports line, with `more` 0.
It fails with 1 on 101077e2: the items carry no `tasks` or `settled`, and Home shows the settled line first.

The product reason. Home is where the owner reads what the supervisor wants of them. A line saying four reports wait for review, when none does, sends the owner to look for work that is not there, or teaches them to ignore the card. Saying what became of the tasks a line names, and taking a settled line off the card, keeps what the supervisor says to the owner true.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green and add tests of your own for the new behaviour: attention.rs unit tests of how a line names its tasks (each form, a list with "and", a number that names no task, the live line above), a serve test of `tasks` and `settled` through the real store, and web/test tests for (c) and (d).
